title: Interest versus Commitment
coreMove: Test whether a goal is merely interesting or binding enough to command action when it becomes inconvenient.
sourcePressure: The chapter separates casual preference from durable commitment when comfort, convenience, or mood no longer cooperate.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating commitment as stronger enthusiasm instead of a different standard of follow-through.

sourceAnchors.name: Interest versus Commitment
sourceAnchors.detail: The verified chapter title establishes the contrast between weaker preference and durable commitment.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Interest likes the result until the week asks for a cost; commitment pays the cost.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
